exempt.NetworkCheck.DifftestMain: the difftest against certificate.py, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of NetworkCheck.Difftest.main, audited under NetworkCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.NetworkCheck.Main: the network-check executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.Protocol.main of NetworkCheck.Check.protocol, audited under NetworkCheck
exempt.NetworkCheck.RecordsMain: the network-records executable's entry point: Core.Protocol.main of NetworkCheck.Records.protocol, or Difftest.serve of its verdicts, audited under NetworkCheck

NetworkCheck.DifftestMain.why: 2,000 random instances on which NetworkCheck.Certificate gives what verity/core/protocols/certifier/certificate.py gives, byte for byte: depth, E_0 … E_D, real_frames, frame_leaf, frames_root, open_frame, verify_frame on openings and tampered ones, parameters_digest and its canonical JSON, record_head and RecordHead's encoding and digest, certificate_message and node, with each ValueError a refusal

NetworkCheck.Certificate.why: the encodings are code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes and canonical JSON, and core's tagged SHA-512 only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NetworkCheck.Check.why: the check is code: the record's encodings, the certifier program's Program grid and Σ_sync, the LMS verifier and the core protocol interface, no Mathlib and nothing of Security

NetworkCheck.Records.why: the check over raw, committed and certified records is code: v2's check, and the difftest server's line protocol for its verdicts, no Mathlib and nothing of Security
